date.as_written: saṃvat || 1765 || samaya nāma phālgu vadi 5(6) vāre atavārake

notes: The place string 'kāsma madhomani kanikā samīpe' corruptly represents Kāśyāṃ madhye Maṇikarṇikā-samīpe (at Maṇikarṇikā in Varanasi). The catalogue suggests Śaka era [ŚS] 1765 (= 1843 CE), but a 4-digit 'saṃvat' in North Indian Devanagari manuscripts generally denotes Vikrama Saṃvat (= 1708 CE).
